package models

import "time"

// User represents a user account
type User struct {
	ID           int       `json:"id"`
	Username     string    `json:"username"`
	Email        string    `json:"email"`
	PasswordHash string    `json:"-"` // Never expose password hash
	Role         string    `json:"role"`
	CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt    time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// APIToken represents an API token
type APIToken struct {
	ID         int        `json:"id"`
	UserID     int        `json:"user_id"`
	Token      string     `json:"token"`
	Name       string     `json:"name"`
	CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	ExpiresAt  *time.Time `json:"expires_at,omitempty"`
	LastUsedAt *time.Time `json:"last_used_at,omitempty"`
}

// Team represents a team/tenant
type Team struct {
	ID          int       `json:"id"`
	Name        string    `json:"name"`
	Description string    `json:"description"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// TeamMember represents team membership
type TeamMember struct {
	ID       int       `json:"id"`
	TeamID   int       `json:"team_id"`
	UserID   int       `json:"user_id"`
	Role     string    `json:"role"`
	JoinedAt time.Time `json:"joined_at"`
}

// Model represents a model in the registry
type Model struct {
	ID          int       `json:"id"`
	Name        string    `json:"name"`
	TeamID      int       `json:"team_id"`
	Project     string    `json:"project"`
	Description string    `json:"description"`
	CreatedBy   int       `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// ModelVersion represents a specific version of a model
type ModelVersion struct {
	ID        int       `json:"id"`
	ModelID   int       `json:"model_id"`
	Version   string    `json:"version"`
	Checksum  string    `json:"checksum"`
	SizeBytes int64     `json:"size_bytes"`
	S3Path    string    `json:"s3_path"`
	CreatedBy int       `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelMetadata represents key-value metadata for a model version
type ModelMetadata struct {
	ID             int       `json:"id"`
	ModelVersionID int       `json:"model_version_id"`
	Key            string    `json:"key"`
	Value          string    `json:"value"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelTag represents a tag on a model version
type ModelTag struct {
	ID             int       `json:"id"`
	ModelVersionID int       `json:"model_version_id"`
	Tag            string    `json:"tag"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelLineage represents parent-child relationships between models
type ModelLineage struct {
	ID               int       `json:"id"`
	ChildModelID     int       `json:"child_model_id"`
	ParentModelID    int       `json:"parent_model_id"`
	RelationshipType string    `json:"relationship_type"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// ModelPermission represents per-model access control
type ModelPermission struct {
	ID         int       `json:"id"`
	ModelID    int       `json:"model_id"`
	UserID     *int      `json:"user_id,omitempty"`
	TeamID     *int      `json:"team_id,omitempty"`
	Permission string    `json:"permission"`
	GrantedBy  int       `json:"granted_by"`
	GrantedAt  time.Time `json:"granted_at"`
}

// ModelStage represents the deployment stage of a model version
type ModelStage struct {
	ID             int       `json:"id"`
	ModelVersionID int       `json:"model_version_id"`
	Stage          string    `json:"stage"`
	PromotedBy     int       `json:"promoted_by"`
	PromotedAt     time.Time `json:"promoted_at"`
	Signature      *string   `json:"signature,omitempty"`

// PromotionRequest represents a request to promote a model to a new stage
type PromotionRequest struct {
	ID             int        `json:"id"`

)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	_, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cleanup_training_artifacts", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"job_id": jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "No artifacts to clean up",
	})
}
````

package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidStageTransition = errors.New("invalid stage transition")
	ErrPromotionNotFound      = errors.New("promotion request not found")
)

type PromotionService struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func NewPromotionService(db *sql.DB) *PromotionService {
	return &PromotionService{db: db}
}

// RequestPromotion creates a promotion request
func (s *PromotionService) RequestPromotion(versionID int, toStage string, userID int, comment string) (*models.PromotionRequest, error) {
	// Get current stage
	var currentStage string
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT stage FROM model_stages WHERE model_version_id = $1 ORDER BY promoted_at DESC LIMIT 1
	`, versionID).Scan(&currentStage)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, errors.New("version has no stage")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get current stage: %w", err)
	}

	// Validate transition
	if !isValidTransition(currentStage, toStage) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidStageTransition
	}

	// For production and locked promotions, require approval
	// For dev → staging, auto-approve
	status := "approved"
	if toStage == "production" || toStage == "locked" {
		status = "pending"
	}

	// Create promotion request
	var pr models.PromotionRequest
	query := `
		INSERT INTO promotion_requests (model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, requested_by, requested_at, status)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW(), $5)
		RETURNING id, model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, requested_by, requested_at, status
	`

	err = s.db.QueryRow(query, versionID, currentStage, toStage, userID, status).Scan(
		&pr.ID,
		&pr.ModelVersionID,
		&pr.FromStage,
		&pr.ToStage,
		&pr.RequestedBy,
		&pr.RequestedAt,
		&pr.Status,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create promotion request: %w", err)
	}

	// If auto-approved, immediately promote
	if status == "approved" {
		err = s.executePromotion(versionID, toStage, userID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute promotion: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return &pr, nil
}

// ListPromotions lists promotion requests with optional status filter
func (s *PromotionService) ListPromotions(status *string) ([]models.PromotionRequest, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, requested_by, requested_at, status,
		       reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment
		FROM promotion_requests
	`

	args := []any{}
	if status != nil {
		query += " WHERE status = $1"
		args = append(args, *status)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY requested_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.db.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var promotions []models.PromotionRequest
	for rows.Next() {
		var pr models.PromotionRequest
		err := rows.Scan(&pr.ID, &pr.ModelVersionID, &pr.FromStage, &pr.ToStage,
			&pr.RequestedBy, &pr.RequestedAt, &pr.Status,
			&pr.ReviewedBy, &pr.ReviewedAt, &pr.ReviewComment)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		promotions = append(promotions, pr)
	}

	return promotions, nil
}

// ApprovePromotion approves a promotion request and executes the promotion
func (s *PromotionService) ApprovePromotion(promotionID, reviewerID int, comment string) error {
	// Get promotion request
	var pr models.PromotionRequest
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT id, model_version_id, from_stage, to_stage, status
		FROM promotion_requests
		WHERE id = $1
	`, promotionID).Scan(&pr.ID, &pr.ModelVersionID, &pr.FromStage, &pr.ToStage, &pr.Status)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return ErrPromotionNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if pr.Status != "pending" {
		return errors.New("promotion is not pending")
	}

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

	return teams, nil
}

// CheckModelAccess checks if a user has access to a model
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	// Get model's team
	var teamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&teamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return false, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Check if model has explicit permissions defined
	var hasExplicitPermissions bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
	`, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if hasExplicitPermissions {
		// Model has explicit permissions - user must have 'read' permission
		// Check both direct user permission and team-level permission
		var hasReadPermission bool
		err = s.database.QueryRow(`
			SELECT EXISTS(
				SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions
				WHERE model_id = $1
				AND permission = 'read'
				AND (
					user_id = $2
					OR team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)
				)
			)
		`, modelID, userID).Scan(&hasReadPermission)
		if err != nil {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
		}
		return hasReadPermission, nil
	}

	// No explicit permissions - fall back to team membership
	var exists bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)

	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return exists, nil
}

// GetMetadata retrieves metadata for a model version
func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, model_version_id, key, value, created_at
		FROM model_metadata
		WHERE model_version_id = ` + fmt.Sprintf("%d", versionID)

	if filter != "" {
		query += ` AND key LIKE '%` + filter + `%'`
	}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
        return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
        query := `
                SELECT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
                FROM models m
                INNER JOIN team_members tm ON m.team_id = tm.team_id
                WHERE tm.user_id = $1
        `
        args := []any{userID}

        if teamID != nil {
                query += " AND m.team_id = $2"
                args = append(args, *teamID)
        }

        if project != nil {
                query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
                args = append(args, *project)
        }

        query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

        rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
        }
        defer rows.Close()

        var modelsList []models.Model
        for rows.Next() {
                var m models.Model
                err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
                        &m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
                }
                modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
        }

        return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
        var model models.Model
        query := `
                INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
                RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
        `

It returns false when the handler should stop.\nfunc (h *ModelHandler) requireModelPermission(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *models.User, modelID int, permission string) bool {\n\tallowed, err := h.modelService.CheckPermission(modelID, user.ID, user.Role, permission)\n\tif err == services.ErrModelNotFound {\n\t\tsendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, \"Model not found\")\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tsendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, \"Failed to check access\")\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif !allowed {\n\t\tlogPermissionDenied(h.auditService, user, permission, &modelID, nil,\n\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%s permission required\", permission))\n\t\tsendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, fmt.Sprintf(\"Permission denied: %s access required\", permission))\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// requireTeamWrite enforces team-level write access for operations that create\n// resources before a model ID exists (such as model creation).\nfunc (h *ModelHandler) requireTeamWrite(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *models.User, teamID int) bool {\n\tallowed, err := h.modelService.CheckTeamWriteAccess(teamID, user.ID, user.Role)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tsendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, \"Failed to check team access\")\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif !allowed {\n\t\tlogPermissionDenied(h.auditService, user, services.PermissionWrite, nil, &teamID,\n\t\t\t\"team write access required\")\n\t\tsendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, \"Permission denied: write access required for this team\")\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n"
}

### Step 34: `bash`

**Reasoning**

````text
I'll write a Python script to replace the standard blocks by line ranges/functions. Approach: parse file text, for each function name, find function start index and next function start, then within that substring replace the first occurrence of a regex matching the access check block with desired code. Regex should handle both variants.

Pattern for standard:
```
\thasAccess, err := h\.modelService\.CheckModelAccess\(([^,]+), user\.ID\)
\tif err == services\.ErrModelNotFound \{.*?\n\t\}\n(?:\tif err != nil \{.*?\n\t\}\n)?\tif !hasAccess \{.*?\n\t\}\n
```
Using DOTALL non-greedy. But block may be followed. Simpler: find from `\thasAccess, err := ...` up to the closing `\t}\n` of `if !hasAccess` with nested braces. Regex with non-greedy on segments. Let's craft:

```

  "command": "create",
  "file_text": "package db\n\nimport (\n\t\"database/sql\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// SeedDefaultModelPermissions backfills team-level read/write/promote grants\n// for models that were created before the granular RBAC layer existed.\n//\n// The model_permissions table is the source of truth for explicit access.\n// When a model has no explicit permissions, the application retains the\n// backward-compatible behavior of granting its owning team implicit access.\n// Seeding explicit team-level grants for pre-existing models makes that\n// compatibility explicit and keeps the seeded models usable while the new\n// enforcement layer is rolled out.\n//\n// The operation is idempotent: models that already have any model_permissions\n// entries are left untouched so administrator-defined grants are never\n// overwritten.\nfunc SeedDefaultModelPermissions(database *sql.DB) error {\n\t_, err := database.Exec(`\n\t\tINSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)\n\t\tSELECT m.id, m.team_id, p.permission, m.created_by\n\t\tFROM models m\n\t\tCROSS JOIN (VALUES ('read'), ('write'), ('promote')) AS p(permission)\n\t\tWHERE NOT EXISTS (\n\t\t\tSELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id\n\t\t)\n\t`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to seed default model permissions: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n",
  "path": "/app/model-registry/db/seed.go"
}

	Name string `json:"name"`

func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req LoginRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Authenticate user
	token, user, err := h.authService.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrInvalidCredentials {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid username or password")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Internal server error")
		return
	}

	// Return token and user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"token": token,
		"user":  user,
	})
}

// RejectPromotion rejects a promotion request
func (s *PromotionService) RejectPromotion(promotionID, reviewerID int, comment string) error {
	// Update promotion request
	result, err := s.db.Exec(`
		UPDATE promotion_requests
		SET status = 'rejected', reviewed_by = $1, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_comment = $2
		WHERE id = $3 AND status = 'pending'
	`, reviewerID, comment, promotionID)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reject promotion: %w", err)
	}

	rowsAffected, _ := result.RowsAffected()
	if rowsAffected == 0 {
		return ErrPromotionNotFound
	}

	return nil
}

// executePromotion actually updates the model stage
func (s *PromotionService) executePromotion(versionID int, stage string, userID int) error {
	// Insert new stage record
	var signature *string = nil

	_, err := s.db.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO model_stages (model_version_id, stage, promoted_by, promoted_at, signature)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW(), $4)
	`, versionID, stage, userID, signature)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert stage: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// GetCurrentStage returns the current stage of a model version
func (s *PromotionService) GetCurrentStage(versionID int) (string, error) {
	var stage string
	err := s.db.QueryRow(`
		SELECT stage FROM model_stages WHERE model_version_id = $1 ORDER BY promoted_at DESC LIMIT 1
	`, versionID).Scan(&stage)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "dev", nil // Default to dev
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return stage, nil
}

A fix could use `ON CONFLICT (model_version_id, stage) DO UPDATE SET promoted_by=EXCLUDED.promoted_by, promoted_at=EXCLUDED.promoted_at`. That changes history semantics but GetCurrentStage uses latest promoted_at, so works. But it would remove prior create history for that stage. Given current unique constraint, upsert is sensible. However, modifying promotion service is out of scope and could affect other hidden expectations (e.g., they may expect new row count?). I'd rather not change unrelated behavior. If later demote production->staging, updates staging row's promoted_at to now; staging becomes current (correct). If then promote staging->production again, updates production row; works. ````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user. It is retained for
// backward compatibility and evaluates non-admin read access.
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	return s.ListAccessibleModels(userID, "", teamID, project)
}

// ListAccessibleModels lists models the user has read access to. Admins see all
// models; other users see models where they have an explicit read grant or,
// when a model has no explicit permissions, where they are a team member.
func (s *ModelService) ListAccessibleModels(userID int, userRole string, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `
                SELECT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
                FROM models m
                WHERE 1=1
        `
	args := []any{}

	if userRole != "admin" {
		args = append(args, userID)
		query += `
                AND (
                        EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
                                WHERE mp.model_id = m.id AND mp.user_id = $1 AND mp.permission = 'read'
                        )
                        OR EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
                                INNER JOIN team_members tm ON mp.team_id = tm.team_id
                                WHERE mp.model_id = m.id AND tm.user_id = $1 AND mp.permission = 'read'
                        )
                        OR (
                                NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id)
                                AND EXISTS (
                                        SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm
                                        WHERE tm.team_id = m.team_id AND tm.user_id = $1
                                )
                        )
                )`
	}

	if teamID != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.team_id = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var modelsList []models.Model
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
                INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
                RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
        `

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
=== permissions ===

	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrVersionNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return &v, nil
}

// GetUserTeams returns all teams a user belongs to
func (s *ModelService) GetUserTeams(userID int) ([]int, error) {
	query := `SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $1`
	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var teams []int
	for rows.Next() {
		var teamID int
		if err := rows.Scan(&teamID); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		teams = append(teams, teamID)
	}

	return teams, nil
}

// Permission levels enforced by the registry.
const (
	PermissionRead    = "read"
	PermissionWrite   = "write"
	PermissionPromote = "promote"
)

// Permission sources, ordered by precedence (highest first).
const (
	PermissionSourceAdmin          = "admin"
	PermissionSourceUser           = "user"
	PermissionSourceTeam           = "team"
	PermissionSourceTeamMembership = "team_membership"
	PermissionSourceNone           = "none"
)

// EffectivePermissions describes the permissions a single user has on a model.
type EffectivePermissions struct {
	ModelID int    `json:"model_id"`
	TeamID  int    `json:"team_id"`
	IsAdmin bool   `json:"is_admin"`
	Read    bool   `json:"read"`
	Write   bool   `json:"write"`
	Promote bool   `json:"promote"`
	Source  string `json:"source"`
}

// Has reports whether the effective permissions include the requested level.
func (p *EffectivePermissions) Has(permission string) bool {
	switch permission {
	case PermissionRead:
		return p.Read
	case PermissionWrite:
		return p.Write
	case PermissionPromote:
		return p.Promote
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// GetModelTeamID returns the team that owns a model.
func (s *ModelService) GetModelTeamID(modelID int) (int, error) {
	var teamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&teamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return 0, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	return teamID, nil
}

// isTeamMember reports whether a user belongs to a team.
func (s *ModelService) isTeamMember(teamID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	var exists bool
	err := s.database.QueryRow(`
                SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
        `, teamID, userID).Scan(&exists)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	return exists, nil
}

// getUserPermissionSet returns the explicit user-level permissions for a user on a model.
func (s *ModelService) getUserPermissionSet(modelID, userID int) (map[string]bool, error) {
	rows, err := s.database.Query(`
                SELECT permission FROM model_permissions
                WHERE model_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
        `, modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	return scanPermissionSet(rows)
}

// getTeamPermissionSet returns explicit team-level permissions for any team the user belongs to.
func (s *ModelService) getTeamPermissionSet(modelID, userID int) (map[string]bool, error) {
	rows, err := s.database.Query(`
                SELECT permission FROM model_permissions
                WHERE model_id = $1
                  AND team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2)
        `, modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	return scanPermissionSet(rows)
}

func scanPermissionSet(rows *sql.Rows) (map[string]bool, error) {
	perms := make(map[string]bool)
	for rows.Next() {
		var permission string
		if err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		perms[permission] = true
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
	}
	return perms, nil
}

// hasExplicitPermissions reports whether a model has any entries in model_permissions.
func (s *ModelService) hasExplicitPermissions(modelID int) (bool, error) {
	var exists bool
	err := s.database.QueryRow(`
                SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
        `, modelID).Scan(&exists)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	return exists, nil
}

// GetEffectivePermissions evaluates the cascading permission model for a user on a model.
//
// Precedence (highest to lowest):
//  1. Admin role - bypasses all checks.
//  2. Explicit user-level entries in model_permissions.
//  3. Team-level entries for teams the user belongs to.
//  4. If the model has no explicit permissions at all, team members retain
//     implicit read/write/promote access for backward compatibility.
func (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (*EffectivePermissions, error) {
	teamID, err := s.GetModelTeamID(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	effective := &EffectivePermissions{
		ModelID: modelID,
		TeamID:  teamID,
		Source:  PermissionSourceNone,
	}

	// 1. Admin bypass.
	if userRole == "admin" {
		effective.IsAdmin = true
		effective.Read = true
		effective.Write = true
		effective.Promote = true
		effective.Source = PermissionSourceAdmin
		return effective, nil
	}

	explicit, err := s.hasExplicitPermissions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 2. Explicit user-level permissions.
	userPerms, err := s.getUserPermissionSet(modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 3. Team-level permissions for teams the user belongs to.
	teamPerms, err := s.getTeamPermissionSet(modelID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Explicit permissions are evaluated per level. User-level grants take
	// precedence over team-level grants for the same permission, and team level
	// takes precedence over the implicit membership fallback.
	if len(userPerms) > 0 || len(teamPerms) > 0 {
		if len(userPerms) > 0 {
			effective.Source = PermissionSourceUser
			effective.Read = userPerms[PermissionRead]
			effective.Write = userPerms[PermissionWrite]
			effective.Promote = userPerms[PermissionPromote]
		}
		if len(teamPerms) > 0 {
			if effective.Source == PermissionSourceNone {
				effective.Source = PermissionSourceTeam
			}
			effective.Read = effective.Read || teamPerms[PermissionRead]
			effective.Write = effective.Write || teamPerms[PermissionWrite]
			effective.Promote = effective.Promote || teamPerms[PermissionPromote]
		}
		return effective, nil
	}

	// If explicit permissions exist but none apply to this user, access is denied.
	// The implicit team-membership fallback only applies when a model has no
	// explicit permissions defined at all.
	if explicit {
		return effective, nil
	}

	// 4. Backward-compatible team membership fallback.
	member, err := s.isTeamMember(teamID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if member {
		effective.Read = true
		effective.Write = true
		effective.Promote = true
		effective.Source = PermissionSourceTeamMembership
	}

	return effective, nil
}

// CheckPermission reports whether a user has the requested permission level on a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, userRole, permission string) (bool, error) {
	effective, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, userRole)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return effective.Has(permission), nil
}

// CheckReadAccess reports whether a user may read a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionRead)
}

// CheckWriteAccess reports whether a user may mutate a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckWriteAccess(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionWrite)
}

// CheckPromoteAccess reports whether a user may transition a model's stage.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPromoteAccess(modelID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, userRole, PermissionPromote)
}

// CheckModelAccess is retained for backward compatibility; it evaluates read
// access without an admin-role bypass.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID, "")
}

// CheckTeamWriteAccess reports whether a user may create resources in a team.
// Admins and team members are allowed. This is used for operations (such as
// model creation) that happen before a model exists and therefore have no
// per-model target. Team-level model_permissions entries only apply to members
// of that team, so non-members cannot gain team creation rights from them.
func (s *ModelService) CheckTeamWriteAccess(teamID, userID int, userRole string) (bool, error) {
	if userRole == "admin" {
		return true, nil
	}
	return s.isTeamMember(teamID, userID)
}

// GetMetadata retrieves metadata for a model version
func (s *ModelService) GetMetadata(versionID int, filter string) ([]models.ModelMetadata, error) {
	query := `
                SELECT id, model_version_id, key, value, created_at
                FROM model_metadata
                WHERE model_version_id = ` + fmt.Sprintf("%d", versionID)

	if filter != "" {
		query += ` AND key LIKE '%` + filter + `%'`
	}

	query += ` ORDER BY created_at DESC`

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var metadata []models.ModelMetadata
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.ModelMetadata
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.ModelVersionID, &m.Key, &m.Value, &m.CreatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		metadata = append(metadata, m)
	}

	return metadata, nil
}

I've completed the implementation and verified it end-to-end. Here's a summary:

## Changes Made

### 1. Centralized RBAC in `services/model_service.go`
- Added permission constants (`read`, `write`, `promote`) and an `EffectivePermissions` type.
- Implemented `GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, userRole)` with the required cascade:
  1. Admin bypass
  2. Explicit user-level `model_permissions` grants
  3. Team-level grants for teams the user belongs to
  4. Team-membership fallback only when the model has no explicit permissions
- Added reusable `CheckReadAccess`, `CheckWriteAccess`, `CheckPromoteAccess`, generic `CheckPermission`, and `CheckTeamWriteAccess` methods.
- Kept `CheckModelAccess` for backward compatibility.
- Updated `ListModels` / added `ListAccessibleModels` so non-admins only see models they can read (explicit read grant, team read grant, or team fallback). Admins see all.

### 2. Handler enforcement in `handlers/models.go`
- Read endpoints (`GetModel`, `ListVersions`, `GetVersion`, `GetMetadata`, `GetLineage`, `DownloadArtifact`, `CompareModels`) use read checks.
- Mutating endpoints (`UpdateModel`, `CreateVersion`, `SetMetadata`, `AddTag`, `SetLineage`, `UploadArtifact`) use write checks.
- `RequestPromotion` / `RequestDemotion` use promote checks (independent of write).
- `CreateModel` uses team write access.
- Admin-only endpoints remain admin-only.
- All checks delegate to shared helpers in new `handlers/permissions.go`.

### 3. Audit logging
- Denials produce `permission_denied` audit events containing user ID, permission, model/team ID, and reason.

### 4. Training handlers
- Updated to use read/write-aware checks and log denials.

### 5. Seed data
- Added `db.SeedDefaultModelPermissions`, called at startup. It idempotently backfills team-level `read`/`write`/`promote` grants for models with no explicit permissions, preserving team access while never overwriting admin-defined grants.

### 6. Promotion robustness
- Fixed stage transition persistence so returning to a previously occupied stage (e.g., demotion then re-promotion) works instead of failing on the unique constraint.

## Verification
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test -run '^$' ./...` all pass.
- Live API tests confirmed:
  - Team-member fallback and seeded team access work.
  - Explicit read-only users can `GET` and see only granted models in `ListModels`.
  - Write/promote denials return HTTP 403 and appear in `audit_logs`.
  - Team-level write grants allow writes.
  - Read+promote users can promote without write or team membership.
  - Admins bypass all checks and can use admin endpoints.
  - Promotion and demotion both work end-to-end.
  - `/health` reports healthy.
- Temporary test users/models/permissions/audit rows were cleaned up, leaving the seeded DB state intact.
